$comment: Cross-client parity fixture (Requirement 13.2, design Property 30). Same telemetry and windowStats as slow-leak-es, but English locale. This is the deliberate pair: the flow/volume display strings are byte-identical to the es case (UnitFormatter does not localise the decimal separator), while the Bs strings differ ('.' decimal in en vs ',' in es) — so the pair catches locale divergence in the cost path specifically. See slow-leak-es.json for the full SCHEMA description. All strings derived by running the real Flutter formatters.
name: slow-leak-en
